title: IRT curves with shinyapps
text: modelsirt R package provides interactive Shiny-based application visualizing Item Response Theory (IRT) model curves. package designed researchers, educators, practitioners working psychometric models, offering intuitive way explore understand different IRT models behave various parameter configurations. package allows users interactively manipulate model parameters instantly see changes affect item characteristic curves (ICCs), category response curves (CRCs), item information functions. makes excellent educational tool teaching IRT concepts practical tool model exploration parameter sensitivity analysis.

title: IRT curves with shinyapps
text: modelsirt provides interactive visualizations multiple IRT models, including: Rasch Model: fundamental dichotomous IRT model equal discrimination parameters 1PL: One-parameter logistic model (difficulty ) 2PL: Two-parameter logistic model (difficulty discrimination) 3PL: Three-parameter logistic model (adds lower asymptote/guessing parameter) 4PL: Four-parameter logistic model (adds upper asymptote/carelessness parameter) Graded Response Model (GRM): ordinal polytomous items ordered categories Partial Credit Model (PCM): ordinal items categories represent partial credit Rating Scale Model (RSM): constrained version PCM common threshold spacings across items Generalized Partial Credit Model (GPCM): Extends PCM include item discrimination parameters Nominal Response Model (NRM): unordered categorical responses Thurstonian IRT Model: forced-choice items comparative judgments
